svg.title: Investing Research with Codex
svg.desc: Setup in Codex, collect company disclosures, public news and X leads, verify evidence, publish Markdown and linked Excel, then monitor for changes.
svg.text: Your investing research workflow
Codex runs the research · Markdown explains it · Excel exposes the detail
1 Open the repo in Codex
Guided setup: investing horizon, currency, watchlist, timezone and your own X browser login.
Ask for research now, or configure a supported Codex schedule and verify its first run.
2A Company disclosures
Annual / quarterly reports
Exchange filings and presentations
2B Public web research
News, industry and competitors
Regulators and counterevidence
2C X discovery with Bird
Company, asset and sector searches
Your signed-in session; no API key
3 Codex reads, verifies and records evidence
Save source URLs, dates, pages and coverage. Deduplicate posts and follow original links.
Separate reported facts, assumptions and social claims. Missing sources stay visible.
X is a lead: a post alone cannot silently change a financial fact or the baseline model.
4A Read the Markdown
Business and thesis, source coverage, changes,
scenario results, risks and unresolved questions.
Follow the link to the matching Excel snapshot.
4B Inspect the Excel
History, blue assumption cells, live formulas,
valuation bridge, sensitivities and charts.
Edit → synchronize → recalculate and audit.
5 Repeat when new evidence arrives
Daily or on demand: compare with previous evidence; preserve model versions and user overrides.
Notify for material developments or failures. No-change runs stay quiet only after completed review.
Bounded source coverage · Requires an executing Codex session · Your data stays local · No trade execution
